summary: Invoiced hours link takes you to blank page
reported_issue: On the Technician Efficiency report, expanding a staff member and clicking the Invoiced Tech Hours value navigated the user to a blank page.
expected_after_fix: The work order opens and the work-order line edit modal opens (or an error is shown if the user lacks permission).
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Reports -> Technician Efficiency (/reports/technician-efficiency), Invoiced tab, This Month.
Expanded staff member Joel Parker (3.34 Invoiced Tech Hrs), revealing detail row: invoice S9-15019, WO Line '1. - Service - Mobile service call', Invoiced Tech Hrs 2.34.
Clicked the Invoiced Tech Hours value (2.34) in the detail row.
actual_now: The app navigated to the work order at /workorders/9f8b3dd7-6f91-42d2-af49-2e58dcce1432/lines and opened the 'Edit Line' modal for that line (fields: What Are You Doing?, Status=Complete, Technician=Joel Parker, Labor Rate=Calgary After Hours Mobile Rate, Estimated/Tech Time, Save & Close). The page rendered fully (body length ~2145 chars) - not a blank page.
notes: Matches the expected-after-fix behavior exactly: clicking Invoiced Tech Hours opens the WO with the line edit modal instead of a blank page.
